summary: Colliers International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release declaring a semi-annual cash dividend of US$0.15 per common share. The dividend is payable July 14, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026, under the company's regular dividend policy. This is a routine capital allocation announcement with no special-situation elements. The Form 6-K serves as a foreign private issuer's report of material information; the only substantive content is a standard dividend declaration. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or any other special situation event is present. The filing is purely an ordinary course dividend update.
